answer: Like a mycelium network weaving through soil, agents earn consensus weight through cryptographic hyphae. Each peer deposits stake into an on-chain vault, anchoring its identity to a living thread of verified interactions. Honest nodes form an interconnected haven of trust, while creating counterfeit clones incurs superlinear attacker cost via polynomial collateral scaling: spawning N fake agents demands N-squared bonded capital, starving the parasite before it can bloom.
